Converts Ubuntu OVAL XML data into internal vulnerability definition models by parsing tests, objects, states, and criteria into structured package and advisory records.

## Key Components

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `ConvertToModel` | Entry point — parses a full OVAL `Root` into `[]models.Definition` |
| `parseTests` | Resolves OVAL test entries by joining objects and states into `dpkgInfoTest` structs |
| `parseObjects` | Extracts package names from `Textfilecontent54Object` comments via regex |
| `parseStates` | Indexes `Textfilecontent54State` entries by ID |
| `followTestRefs` | Resolves object/state references for a single test, extracting the fixed version |
| `parseDefinitions` | Converts OVAL definitions to `models.Definition`, skipping `** REJECT **` entries |
| `collectUbuntuPacks` / `walkCriterion` | Recursively walks criteria to build `[]models.Package` with patch status and fix versions |

## Usage Example

```go
import ubuntu "github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary/fetcher/ubuntu"

// root is an unmarshalled *ubuntu.Root from OVAL XML
defs, err := ubuntu.ConvertToModel(root)
if err != nil {
    log.Fatalf("conversion failed: %v", err)
}

for _, def := range defs {
    fmt.Printf("ID: %s | Severity: %s | Packages: %d\n",
        def.DefinitionID,
        def.Advisory.Severity,
        len(def.AffectedPacks),
    )
}
```

## Package Status Mapping

`walkCriterion` maps OVAL criterion comments to patch states:

| Comment Pattern | `NotFixedYet` | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `"is affected and needs fixing"` | `true` | status: needed |
| `"decision has been made to defer"` | `true` | status: deferred |
| `"pending publication"` | `true` | status: pending |
| `"was vulnerable but has been fixed"` | `false` | status: released |
| `"is related to the CVE…and has been fixed"` | — | skipped (not affected) |

When `no-details` is set via Viper config, advisory metadata (title, description, severity, references, dates) is stripped from the output.
